cases.name: regex guard ends at its stated input formula and skips guest cleanup
cases.document:
kernel 1
numbers by_spelling
use regex.ecma.test = @32a56c05dec1999e8c320d453e09f9debf92ed19699bcb4f0bd3c763730cfba7
main { let r = {"brand": "regex.ecma", "pattern": "(a+)+b", "flags": "", "lastIndex": 0} try { print regex.ecma.test(r, "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa") } catch e { print "caught" } finally { print "cleanup" } finish null }

cases.name: same regex arguments stay deterministic with a warm pattern cache
cases.document:
kernel 1
numbers by_spelling
use regex.ecma.test = @32a56c05dec1999e8c320d453e09f9debf92ed19699bcb4f0bd3c763730cfba7
use eq = @f537bb3edf9746f3847d63ebb49e6f4f440f52d258e658ed3e1f57336dba4a25
main { let r = {"brand": "regex.ecma", "pattern": "a", "flags": "g", "lastIndex": 0} let a = regex.ecma.test(r, "ab") let b = regex.ecma.test(r, "ab") finish [eq(a, b), r.lastIndex] }
